requirements.title: Scenario-based gameplay
requirements.description: Custom scenarios focusing on planning and managing AI projects
acceptance_criteria: Game offers a variety of customizable scenarios for AI project management

requirements.title: Adjustable difficulty levels
requirements.description: Cater to different experience levels in AI
acceptance_criteria: Users can select and adjust the difficulty level of scenarios

requirements.title: Feedback system
requirements.description: Show the impact of decisions and provide learning points
acceptance_criteria: Users receive feedback on their decisions, including explanations for success or failure

requirements.title: Progress tracking
requirements.description: Track users' progress through levels and scenario completions
acceptance_criteria: Users can view their progress in the game, including completed scenarios and levels

requirements.title: Dynamic consequences
requirements.description: Choices lead to varying success levels based on timeline estimates, resource allocation, and deliverable definitions
acceptance_criteria: Users' decisions in the game have real-world implications, such as project delays or cost overruns

requirements.title: AI glossary or tooltips
requirements.description: Help users unfamiliar with terms (e.g., 'machine learning', 'model training')
acceptance_criteria: Game provides definitions and explanations for AI-related terminology

requirements.title: Scoreboards
requirements.description: Allow users to compete asynchronously with peers in leaderboards
acceptance_criteria: Users can view a leaderboard showing their rank and scores compared to other players

requirements.title: Subscription-based platform
requirements.description: Offer the game as a subscription for educational purposes
acceptance_criteria: Users can subscribe to access the game, with options for monthly or annual subscriptions

requirements.title: Custom, evolving scenarios
requirements.description: Provide users with new and updated scenarios to practice AI project management
acceptance_criteria: Scenarios are regularly updated and rotated to keep the game fresh and relevant

requirements.title: Real-world business scenarios focus
requirements.description: Focus on specific, real-world business scenarios for educational relevance
acceptance_criteria: All scenarios are based on real-world business situations
